crop.notes: The closing paragraphs of 'Sports at Hot Springs: Veterans Who Attended the Recent Pugilistic Fiasco'; the headline and start are elsewhere on the page (and the Watkins paragraph is article 921). The Allen mention, the last paragraph, is complete.

ocr.notes: Minor errors ('Mast' for East, 'Fc' for from, 'Tom Alle' and '"Bat —terson' for Bat Masterson).

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch listed Tom Allen and Tom Kelly of St. Louis, Mike Donovan and Bat Masterson among the old-time ring regulars who stayed away from the failed championship fight gathering at Hot Springs.

metadata.notes: Masthead: 'The Sunday Post-Dispatch, Part Four, St. Louis, Sunday Morning, November 10, 1895'.

notes: A one-line mention with no biographical fact beyond Allen not attending, so no facts recorded.
